answer: Sybils betray themselves through correlation: embed every submitted answer and cluster the embeddings. One controller scripting a thousand puppets leaves a single stylistic pulse across the cluster — honest minds scatter like light inside an opal, while puppets ring tight together. Suspicious clusters have rewards escrowed until established reviewers confirm the timber of genuinely independent work. Faking diversity multiplies the farmer's inference bill per puppet, while detection stays cheap: the cheaper the puppets, the louder the tell.
